groups.summary: The README was 215 lines of reference-grade prose. The opening paragraph ran ten sentences and mixed the pitch with the systemd slice name and the workspace identifier, Install carried the complete dependency list, and "What it does" was eight dense paragraphs down to nftables sets and socket2 events. The features that would sell the plugin were in there, but a reader had to mine for them.
groups.title: A reference manual on the front page

groups.summary: A person landing on the repository page should be able to tell in about a minute what the plugin does and whether they want it. The reference material stays in the repository: it moves out of the README into the docs, so the README becomes the pitch and the quick path in, and the docs stay the complete account.
groups.title: The README pitches, the docs keep the full account

files.summary: Rewritten as the pitch: one sentence, the feature list with its screenshots, how it works, install, use, configure, remove, contributing, and links; sections that gave material up link to where it went.

groups.summary: The README opens with the title and one sentence saying the plugin makes distractions hard to reach, with no image above the feature list. The seven-item list puts the site block and the lock first, then the distraction space, links, notifications, sounds, and the come-back summary. It is 83 lines; the keys table and the bar-widget paragraph are unchanged; the Upgrading from 2.x section and the pre-2.1.0 id note are dropped.

groups.summary: The offline suite ran green at head, 517 tests with one skip, and the gate classified the diff as docs-only. A link checker resolved all 37 relative links, images, and anchors in the README and the four docs, and a negative run on the previous README flagged the missing workspace.png, so the checker catches a missing image. Codex was out of quota before round 1. The cursor review on gpt-5.6-sol-high returned NEEDS_WORK in round 1 on a spec contradiction about held-count.png, resolved by amending R9; round 2 was forced once on the maintainer's explicit authorization with the diff unchanged and returned SHIP. The reviewer's pre-existing P3, a redundant chmod line in Install, is recorded as a follow-up.

changeWalkthrough.thesis: The README was a 215-line reference manual; a visitor had to mine it to learn what the plugin does. It is now an 83-line pitch: one sentence that the plugin makes distractions hard to reach, seven features led by the site block and the lock, six maintainer-approved screenshots beside their features, and a short Install section. Every reference fact it held moved to docs/reference.md or docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, except the 2.x upgrade section and the pre-2.1.0 id note, which are dropped. No code, test, or manifest changes.
